legend: No Great Victory anniversary in Berland has ever passed without the war parade. This year is not an exception. That’s why the preparations are on in full strength. Tanks are building a line, artillery mounts are ready to fire, soldiers are marching on the main square... And the air forces general Mr. Generalov is in trouble again. This year a lot of sky-scrapers have been built which makes it difficult for the airplanes to fly above the city. It was decided that the planes should fly strictly from south to north. Moreover, there must be no sky scraper on a plane’s route, otherwise the anniversary will become a tragedy. The Ministry of Building gave the data on n sky scrapers (the rest of the buildings are rather small and will not be a problem to the planes). When looking at the city from south to north as a geometrical plane, the i-th building is a rectangle of height hi. Its westernmost point has the x-coordinate of li and the easternmost — of ri. The terrain of the area is plain so that all the buildings stand on one level. Your task as the Ministry of Defence’s head programmer is to find an enveloping polyline using the data on the sky-scrapers. The polyline’s properties are as follows:
If you look at the city from south to north as a plane, then any part of any building will be inside or on the boarder of the area that the polyline encloses together with the land surface.
The polyline starts and ends on the land level, i.e. at the height equal to 0.
The segments of the polyline are parallel to the coordinate axes, i.e. they can only be vertical or horizontal.
The polyline’s vertices should have integer coordinates.
If you look at the city from south to north the polyline (together with the land surface) must enclose the minimum possible area.
The polyline must have the smallest length among all the polylines, enclosing the minimum possible area with the land.
The consecutive segments of the polyline must be perpendicular.
input: The first input line contains integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000). Then follow n lines, each containing three integers hi, li, ri (1 ≤ hi ≤ 109,  - 109 ≤ li < ri ≤ 109).
output: In the first line output integer m — amount of vertices of the enveloping polyline. The next m lines should contain 2 integers each — the position and the height of the polyline’s vertex. Output the coordinates of each vertex in the order of traversing the polyline from west to east. Remember that the first and the last vertices of the polyline should have the height of 0.

legend.ai: 在 Berland，任何一次伟大胜利纪念日都从未没有阅兵式。今年也不例外。因此，各项准备工作正在全力进行。坦克正在列队，火炮已准备开火，士兵们正在主广场上行进……而空军将军 Generalov 先生又遇到了麻烦。今年建造了许多摩天大楼，这使飞机难以飞越城市上空。人们决定飞机必须严格从南向北飞行。此外，飞机的航线上不能有任何摩天大楼，否则纪念日将变成一场悲剧。建筑部提供了 n 座摩天大楼的数据（其余建筑物都比较矮，不会给飞机造成问题）。从南向北观察城市并将其视为一个几何平面时，第 i 座建筑物是一个高度为 h_i 的矩形。它最西端点的 x 坐标为 l_i，最东端点的 x 坐标为 r_i。该区域地势平坦，因此所有建筑物都建在同一水平面上。作为国防部的首席程序员，你的任务是根据这些摩天大楼的数据找出一条包络折线。该折线具有以下性质：
从南向北观察城市并将其视为一个平面时，任意一座建筑物的任意部分都应位于该折线与地表共同围成的区域内部或边界上。
折线的起点和终点都在地面高度上，即高度为 0。
折线的各条线段都平行于坐标轴，也就是说，它们只能是竖直或水平的。
折线的顶点坐标必须为整数。
从南向北观察城市时，该折线（连同地表）必须围成可能的最小面积。
该折线必须是所有与陆地围成可能最小面积的折线中长度最短的。
折线的相邻线段必须相互垂直。

input.ai: 第一行包含整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 100000）。接下来有 n 行，每行包含三个整数 hi、li、ri（1 ≤ hi ≤ 109，  - 109 ≤ li < ri ≤ 109）。

output.ai: 第一行输出整数 m——包络折线的顶点数量。接下来的 m 行中，每行应包含 2 个整数——折线顶点的位置和高度。按照从西向东遍历折线的顺序输出每个顶点的坐标。请注意，折线的第一个和最后一个顶点的高度应为 0。
